transfer.visualRole: high-visual-system: sharp thin-line institutional layout anatomy, labelled grid, partner-trust strip, restrained accent
principles: The capability grid uses a short all-caps category label above each card title instead of a decorative icon - a direct anatomy match for a proof-forward reimbursement-code and consignment-tag product-teaser card that UNIENS' own product-card category convention already half-implements.

A dedicated Trusted by industry leaders partner-logo strip sits directly under the hero, before any product detail - proof is sequenced immediately after the value claim, not deferred to a later section.

Hairline dividers and a single blue accent line carry all visual structure; there is no rounded-card or drop-shadow softness anywhere, consistent with the straight-line, thin-line, minimal-rounding principle already stated in UNIENS' own stylesheet.
Motion is restrained to a scroll-cue affordance and on-scroll section reveals - no autoplay carousel or looping animation competes with the credibility content.
